C-bucket residue: Reverie store itself contains ~25 entries with stale codex_* tool names, CODEX_* env vars, and .codexcli/ paths described as CURRENT state. The deep-rebrand B-bucket audit (cleared 2026-05-06) swept code/CI/docs/tests but did not sweep the store. Discovered 2026-05-06 via `rvr_find codex` audit. Estimated effort: 1–2 hours, mechanical reverie_set rewrites.

WHY THIS MATTERS: future agents reading these entries will be told the current MCP tool is `codex_audit`, the current env var is `CODEX_DATA_DIR`, the current store dir is `.codexcli/` — none of which are true under v1.0.0-beta.1+. The store contradicts itself: vitest.config.ts already uses RVR_DATA_DIR but conventions.tests + deps.vitest still say CODEX_DATA_DIR.

SWEEP TARGETS (rewrite to current names):

Tool name renames (codex_X → reverie_X, ccli → rvr):
  context.aliasResolvedCapture (codex_copy, codex_run)
  context.bootstrapOverflowMechanics (codex_context, codex_set, codex_get)
  context.confirmFlow (codex_run)
  context.opClassification (codex_remove, codex_alias_remove, codex_confirm_remove, codex_reset, codex_audit)
  context.writeAmpPattern (codex_set in v1.14 guard description)
  arch.audit (codex_audit, ccli audit)
  arch.missPathTracking (codex_get, codex_set)
  arch.staleness (codex_stale, ccli stale)
  arch.tokenSavings (codex_get, codex_set)
  project.vision (codex_stats)
  project.seedRoadmap (ccli lint --seed-quality, ccli topology)

Env var renames (CODEX_* → RVR_*):
  context.mcpCwd (CODEX_PROJECT, CODEX_PROJECT_DIR, "codexcli MCP block in .claude.json")
  context.testDataLeaks (CODEX_DATA_DIR)
  arch.projectResolution (CODEX_NO_PROJECT, CODEX_PROJECT, CODEX_PROJECT_DIR)
  arch.telemetry (CODEX_AGENT_NAME)
  conventions.tests (CODEX_DATA_DIR)
  deps.vitest (CODEX_DATA_DIR)

Path renames (.codexcli/ → .reverie/, ~/.codexcli/ → ~/.reverie/store/ where applicable):
  files.telemetry (~/.codexcli/telemetry.jsonl)
  arch.audit (~/.codexcli/audit.jsonl)
  arch.lint (.codexcli.json)
  arch.scope (.codexcli/, .codexcli.json)
  arch.storage (current-state .codexcli/ language — keep migration mention as legacy)
  arch.storeLayout (current-state .codexcli/ language — keep migration mention as legacy)
  arch.telemetry (~/.codexcli/telemetry.jsonl)
  conventions.editSurface (.codexcli.json, .codexcli/*.json — present-tense)
  conventions.persistence (.codexcli/)
  project.goals (.codexcli.json)

Noun "the codex" / "codex" used as system identifier (per project.identity, drop in favor of "Reverie"):
  project.seedRoadmap ("Bake the principle into the codex itself")
  conventions.seedDensity ("Codex entries are seeds...") — note this one is borderline-metaphorical; consider keeping the metaphor but renaming the noun

EXPLICITLY LEAVE ALONE (legitimate historical/back-compat):
  context.migration (migration algorithm legitimately names legacy paths)
  arch.storage / arch.storeLayout migration sections (legacy path references in algorithm description)
  project.releasePlan, project.identity, project.commercialContext, project.inFlight (rebrand narrative)
  project.v112, project.v112patches, project.v114Plan, project.v115Hints (historical milestones — names tools as they existed at that time; rewriting would be revisionist)
  context.next_session at the time it describes this session's commits

EXECUTION NOTE: A simple per-entry reverie_get → rewrite → reverie_set loop. No ordering dependencies. Can be parallelized across an agent session. Verify at end with another `rvr_find codex` and confirm only the legitimate-historical entries remain.

DO BEFORE v1.0.0 STABLE so the store stops contradicting itself.
